item.title: Lightweight Serverless .NET 8 Azure Function Deployment
item.description: This project details the architecture and implementation of a lightweight, non-containerized PaaS deployment for a .NET 8 Azure Function. It features a secure CI/CD pipeline built with Azure DevOps, leveraging Azure’s Flex Consumption plan and zero-trust security principles.

item.title: Zero-Trust Serverless CI/CD with Azure Functions
item.description: Architected and implemented a lightweight, zero-trust CI/CD pipeline for a .NET 8 Azure Function on the Flex Consumption plan. This solution prioritizes speed and security by leveraging native Azure services and eliminating container overhead.
